competences.description: Attacks the enemy and recovers the HP of the ally with the lowest HP status by 10%.
Installs a bomb that detonates after 2 turns on the enemy target and stuns the enemy for 1 turn.

effets.description: When remaining turns reach 0, the bomb explodes to deal damage that ignores Defense and stuns for 1 turn. The damage is affected by the caster's Attack Power, and the chance of stunning is affected by the caster's Accuracy and the target's Resistance.
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: You will gain immunity against Attack Bar decreasing effects. In addition, removes all inability effects on the allies at the start of each turn, and increases the Attack Bar of the allies with the removed inability effects by 30%. [Automatic Effect]

effets.note: Of an ally under inability effects at the start of each turn

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
